name: program-runtime.registry-sweep
purpose: Read the dry-run plan of a safe read-binding sweep and report row counts grouped by the plan's key field, without invoking any binding the sweep would exercise.

scenario.description: Optional scenario filter for the sweep plan.

assumptions: program-runtime is running; the sweep binding is called with dry_run=True only
invariants: execute is never passed; the sweep binding runs its dry-run plan only
no row set is materialized beyond head(1)
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path

signals.first_row_keys: keys of the first plan row
signals.by_key: {key: {value: count}} for the first plan key present among eligible, eligibility, skipReason, skipped, status, effect, scenario
